text: GTA 6 is finally out. Well… in New Zealand.
Thirteen years after GTA 5, the game unlocked at midnight in Auckland, and the biggest streamers on Twitch were already waiting. Over two million people tuned in to watch them play it first.
But first, the final minutes. Some of them stayed calm. Most of them did not.
And then… the timer hit zero.
Next came the settings menu. HutchMF did not read it.
So, first impressions. Was it worth thirteen years?
But not everyone was sold. The first complaint showed up within minutes.
Reports before launch said thirty frames per second on consoles, and the streamers definitely felt it.
Then the actual gameplay started. And GTA 6 humbled people fast.

So, after one hour: GTA 6 looks unbelievable, the frame rate is up for debate, and nobody can fly a plane. America gets it at midnight Eastern, and we'll be watching every big streamer's first hour. Subscribe, so you don't miss it.
